releases.headline: Stage gestures, four-edge gradients, and reliable canvas navigation

sections.title: Stage sidebar
items: Optionally keep the active workspace visible, reserve empty workspace slots, show card backdrops, and distribute cards evenly (#45). Active-card glow is opt-in and disabled by default.
Click a window preview to activate its workspace and focus that window. Floating windows dragged within their own Stage card now retain the dropped position.

Toggle Stage at runtime with `hl.plugin.hymission.stage_toggle()` / `hymission:stage_toggle`. A horizontal plugin gesture reveals or hides the sidebar with continuous desktop reservation, reversal, cancellation, and animated settling. `stage_enabled` now sets startup visibility; config reload preserves the runtime choice. Scrolling layouts translate as a whole without changing column widths or window sizes.

Preserve native rounding, decorations, layering, and return animations when dragging between the desktop and Stage cards. Keep drops in card gaps consistent and prevent silent drops from stealing focus.

sections.title: Rendering
items: Clip scrolling windows and unpinned floating windows at Stage boundaries with progressive blur and fading. Configure desktop and preview bands independently with `stage_scrolling_desktop_edge_width` and `stage_scrolling_preview_edge_width`.
Keep pinned floating windows above Stage with native pointer input, and respect window stacking and fullscreen occlusion in previews.
Preserve live backdrop blur, shadow cutouts, rounded corners, and edge gradients through overview transitions. Correct clipping of closing windows and shadow rendering beyond Stage content.
Apply blur and fading to every overflowing preview edge, including floating previews, while retaining hard clipping when edge widths are zero.

sections.title: Gestures and overview
items: Synchronize sidebar movement and returning cards with workspace swipe progress, including fullscreen transitions, pauses, reversal, and cancellation.
Return overview windows directly to their Stage cards and retain the intended workspace across compact gesture handoffs. Preserve geometry and clipping when releasing or interrupting a gesture.
Fix duplicate sidebar movement and workspace-strip wallpaper rendering. Ignore empty overview opens, limit workspace creation during a single swipe, and correct hover-only preview expansion.
Route layout-scroll gestures to the hovered Stage workspace, preserve its canvas offset when activating it, and scroll explicitly selected windows into view.
Fix the Lua `stage_toggle` action alias so Win+four-finger horizontal gestures register as continuous Stage gestures.
Calculate scrolling auto-follow visibility against the actual desktop area, excluding the Stage sidebar, for both horizontal and vertical layouts.

sections.title: Capture integration
items: Expose rendered Stage window geometry, clipping, stacking, and rounded corners to HyprCapture. Separate screenshot input suppression from rendering so selection does not also activate a workspace.
Avoid render-hook conflicts with Viewflow and transform its shadows with overview previews.

sections.title: Validation
items: CMake Release and Meson Release builds and regression suites validated against Hyprland 0.56.2. Live compositor behavior requires a user-run plugin update and session validation.

releases.headline: Stage workspace sidebar and overview navigation

sections.title: Stage workspace sidebar
items: Add an optional persistent workspace sidebar with live window previews, native gap integration, background blur, and animated workspace transitions. Stage mode is disabled by default.
Add Smartisan mode, alternating the sidebar side on workspace switches.
Support trackpad workspace transitions and dragging windows between sidebar previews, desktops, and workspace cards, with animated drop feedback.
Open overview from sidebar preview positions and preserve floating-window placement during drops.

sections.title: Overview and navigation
items: Add optional Vim navigation with h/j/k/l and forward/backward selection cycling with Tab/Shift+Tab.
Add workspace_strip_force_show and configurable workspace-strip refresh intervals.
Restore the pre-overview window on gesture close by default; set gesture_close_restores_focus = 0 for the previous hover-target behavior. Click and Return activate the selected window.
Fix cross-workspace gesture exit geometry, confirmed selection focus, and scrolling position after overview teardown.

releases.headline: Reliable search startup, shutdown, and system appearance

sections.title: Search fixes
items: Install `hymission-search-input` into `~/.local/bin` during hyprpm builds and locate it directly at runtime. Fixes #38.
Show the search bar immediately when search starts, avoiding an unmapped transparent GTK window that cannot receive its first key.
Keep keyboard focus on the search helper and buffer keys while its surface is becoming ready.
Prevent desktop freezes when closing search: reset inherited signal state, retire helper processes asynchronously, and force termination after a 250 ms grace period.

sections.title: Appearance
items: Follow the system light/dark preference using libadwaita.
Render transparent rounded corners without the rectangular window background, with space for the shadow.
Correct the plugin-reported version to 0.7.1.

releases.headline: Window search, wheel navigation, and rotated-monitor rendering

sections.title: Window navigation
items: Add overview window-title search.
Add mouse-wheel selection cycling.

sections.title: Rendering fixes
items: Fix onlycurrentworkspace previews and workspace-strip thumbnails on rotated and vertical monitors.
Fix hidden bar snapshot orientation, aspect ratio, and animation position on rotated outputs.
Keep arbitrary-size offscreen rendering in framebuffer-local export coordinates and avoid monitor-sized blur framebuffer interference.
Suppress conflicting Hyprglass window glass while overview is active.

sections.title: Documentation
items: Fix the duplicated hypr path in the Lua configuration guide.
Add Lua configuration mode, Omarchy 4, and troubleshooting documentation.

releases.headline: Grouped windows and keyboard picking improvements

sections.title: Grouped windows
items: Add `grouped_windows_policy` with expanded and collapsed overview modes.
Support collapsed group tabs, member switching, selection persistence, and whole-group dragging.
Render inactive group members correctly in expanded overviews and suppress conflicting groupbar behavior while overview is active.

sections.title: Keyboard picking and overview polish
items: Extend spatial keyboard picking across the ANSI punctuation area and allow labels to be hidden while picking remains active.
Separate hover expansion from selection and remove collapsed-tab switching flicker.
Keep multi-surface drag previews rigid and latch preview geometry per frame.

releases.headline: Direct and spatial keyboard window picking

sections.title: Keyboard window picking
items: Added sequential keyboard pick labels with configurable direct activation.
Added spatial mode that maps the physical ANSI alphanumeric grid to window positions across participating monitors.
Spatial badges automatically follow the active XKB keyboard layout while activation remains tied to stable physical keycodes.
Dense overviews support deterministic two-key routes such as FF and FR.

sections.title: Overview polish and fixes
items: Improved workspace-strip window drag and drop transitions.
Added reverse toggle-switch cycling and Lua configuration integration.
Fixed fullscreen overview behavior and isolated closing windows from overview transforms.
Vendored the JSON dependency for reliable clean builds.

sections.title: Hyprland v0.56.0 compatibility
items: Adapted Hymission to Hyprland v0.56.0 state, fullscreen, animation, pointer, workspace, and rendering APIs.
Fixed the v0.56 shouldRenderWindow hook lookup so the overview controller initializes correctly.
hyprpm builds now clear stale CMake cache entries before detecting headers.

releases.headline: Thumbnail layouts, workspace drag and drop, and capture hooks

sections.title: Changes
items: Add thumbnail layout and scoped layout engine overrides.
Support thumbnail workspace drag/drop and relayout refreshes.
Improve thumbnail hover, new-window placement, and workspace movement behavior.
Add overview capture hooks and capture command argument handling.
Update README load instructions.

releases.headline: Configurable scrolling preview gaps and window decorations

sections.title: Changes
items: Add configurable `niri_scrolling_preview_gap` for niri direct scrolling-layout overview previews.
Add overview window border rendering and decoration controls.
Enforce configured overview gaps while preserving niri overview layout behavior.

releases.headline: Cross-workspace animations and gesture focus handoff

sections.title: Changes
items: Fix multi-workspace overview open and close animations so non-current workspace windows enter and leave from off-screen instead of flashing on the active workspace.
Preserve the selected/focused window when crossing from global overview through the recommand gesture into workspace overview.
Synchronize the real active workspace during recommand retargeting so the underlying scene matches the workspace overview.
Notify workspace bars after exiting global overview to a window on another workspace so the active workspace number updates correctly.
Improve overview ergonomics around hover retargeting, close buttons, reserved layer areas, floating window activation, and damage tracking.

releases.headline: Reliable all-workspace rendering and exit focus

sections.title: Changes
items: Fix all-workspace overview rendering after workspace switches by keeping managed workspaces renderable during overview.
Make overview exit focus the hovered, Tab-selected, or clicked window, including cross-workspace targets.
Avoid native workspace animation and offscreen opening frames that could cause full-screen black flashes in overview.

releases.headline: Optional niri mode and improved overview layouts

sections.title: Changes
items: Add opt-in niri scroll mode and niri-style workspace strip behavior.
Improve niri overview geometry for scrolling-layout and floating previews.
Refine natural layout packing, scaling, edge fill, and multi-workspace overview behavior.

sections.title: Release notes
items: The original release provides a source comparison without a written feature summary. Use the comparison below to inspect the changes.

releases.headline: Toggle switch sessions with reliable modifier release

sections.title: Window switching
items: Add optional toggle switch sessions: repeated `hymission:toggle` calls cycle through windows; releasing the configured modifier activates the selection.
Preserve overview ordering and track modifier release across multiple keyboards, focus changes, and missed key events.
Configure with `toggle_switch_mode`, `switch_toggle_auto_next`, and `switch_release_key`; open, close, and gesture behavior remain separate.

sections.title: Changes
items: add animated workspace-strip bar handoff proxies for exclusive bars
fix right-edge cropping for monitor-sized bar snapshots
align default config values with the current live setup
bump the plugin/build version to 0.1.2

releases.headline: Gesture handling and configurable empty workspace slots

sections.title: Highlights
items: Visible `hymission:toggle,*` overview can now exit in either swipe direction.
`recommand` only keeps its continuous two-stage transfer in the side-changing direction; the other direction now just exits back to hidden.
Hidden-start gestures stay locked to a single opening/cancel session until finger lift, so one touch sequence no longer chains into a fresh visible-start return or cross-side handoff.
Added `workspace_strip_empty_mode` with `existing` as the default and optional `continuous` synthetic gap slots.
Synthetic empty strip slots now prefer monitor background / wallpaper layers, while the trailing new-workspace slot keeps its dedicated `+` card styling.
Overview rebuilds now retry briefly when a newly relevant window has not reached usable geometry yet.
Added a standalone mission layout regression test binary and fixed row-height contamination, candidate-search early exits, negative scale clamps, and aspect-ratio preservation regressions.
Synced README, spec, workspace-strip plan notes, and a new dev log for this release.

releases.headline: Workspace strip and two-sided overview gestures

sections.title: Highlights
items: Added the first workspace strip implementation for active-workspace overview mode, including strip previews, click-to-switch behavior, and overview-local workspace transitions.
Added gesture-only `recommand` mode for `hymission:toggle`, so one swipe direction can open `forceall` while the opposite direction opens `onlycurrentworkspace`.
Refined the two-stage gesture handoff so switching from one `recommand` side to the other must pass through hidden state and a small transfer gap instead of flipping immediately.
Fixed `forceall` animation origins and restore targets so windows from other workspaces fly in from, and return to, their off-screen workspace positions.
Updated strip motion so it now slides out on close instead of only sliding in on open.
Improved workspace-switch handling, strip input fallback behavior, and release-facing documentation.

sections.title: Release notes
items: Initial published release. The original release has no written notes and does not specify a target Hyprland version.
